title: aster lanceolatus subsp. hesperius
intro: Aster lanceolatus subsp. hesperius, commonly known as Western Mountain Aster, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is primarily known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Western Mountain Aster include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
